hyps.why: Replacing a missing final edge with a 3x3 conv restores a route into the output, a larger gain than upgrading an existing op.
Adding a conv where there was no edge gives a much larger gain than swapping one op for another.
Creating the direct input-to-output conv path is worth more than upgrading an existing op.
The 1x1 to 3x3 upgrade is a small increment compared with the average gain from other replaced ops.
1x1 already provides much of the benefit, so the upgrade has diminishing returns.
Replacing a 3x3 conv with skip discards learned capacity, unlike replacing a weak op.
Swapping the final conv for skip loses capacity, so the edit is worse than when it replaces a weak op.
Deleting a strong 3x3 conv loses far more accuracy than deleting a pool or other weak op.
With edge 0 absent, node 1 is dead, so a conv on edge 4 does nothing.
With edge 0 absent, node 1 carries no signal, so edge 2 is wasted.
